How to read this: the line with dots is the sliding-window score — each point is a separate forward pass on one window, the granularity the model is trained and calibrated for. That is the trustworthy output. The green shaded strip is the model’s internal attention, which is not a contribution map: occlusion testing shows that silencing the most-attended 25% of a clip changes the prediction no more than silencing a random 25% (see attribution_test.py).
